Description: Occurring first in time or sequence; original; of greatest rank or importance or value.
A clinical, pathologic, and/or molecular finding indicating that the course of a disease is worsening in terms of extent or severity.
The return of a disease after a period of remission.
The spread of a neoplasm from the original site of growth to another site.
A state in which the signs and symptoms of a disease are reduced or absent.
Diagnostic tests fail to detect presence of disease.
